summary: 面向小批量、强实时 AI 工作负载的高性能推理引擎，旗舰接入 Pi0/GR00T 等 VLA 控制。
description: FlashRT is a high-performance realtime inference engine for small-batch, latency-sensitive AI workloads. The flagship integration is production VLA control for Pi0, Pi0.5, GROOT N1.6, and Pi0-FAST. Also support llm e.g, qwen3.6-27B
